text: Good morning. I call to order this Select Committee of the School Board for hearing appeals. It's 9:00 AM on Monday, June 8th, 2026. This morning, we are going to go into closed session. Mr. Pepper, do you have a motion? Yes, Madam Chair. I move that the Loudoun County School Board recess this public meeting and enter into a closed meeting pursuant to Section

2.2-3712 of the Code of Virginia for the following purposes: Discussion or consideration of matters that would involve the disclosure of information contained in a scholastic record concerning a student, namely parent requests for a LCPS student to attend a school outside of their assigned attendance zone, which is authorized by Section 2.2-3711.A2 of the Code of Virginia.

Or discussion or consideration of matters that would involve the disclosure of information contained in respective scholastic records concerning students, namely parents requesting permission by staff for their respective students to be accepted or given early attendance at an existing school, but who missed the survey deadline, as authorized by Section 2.2-3711A2 of the Code of Virginia. Thank you, Mr. Pepper. Mr. Pepper has made a motion to convene a closed meeting. Is there a second?

I second. Thank you, Ms. LaBelle. It has been properly moved and seconded that the Loudoun County School Board convene a closed meeting. Let's move forward with the vote. All those in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. We are now in closed session. The Select Committee of the School Board for hearing appeals on June 8th, 2026, is now coming out of closed session. Mr. Pepper, do you have a motion?

Yes, Madam Chair. I move that the closed meeting be adjourned, that the Loudoun County School Board reconvene its public meeting, and that the minutes of the public meeting reflect that no formal action was taken in the closed meeting. Thank you. Mr. Pepper has made a motion to adjourn the closed meeting. Is there a second? I second. Thank you, Ms. LaBelle. It has been properly moved and seconded that we adjourn the closed meeting. We'll move forward with the vote. All those in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. That motion passes unanimously.

Mr. Pepper, do you have another motion? Yes, Madam Chair. I move that the following resolution certifying the closed meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of the public meeting. Resolution Number 45-25/26, whereas the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act, and whereas Section 2.2-3712D of the Code of Virginia

requires a certification by the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law. Now, therefore, be it resolved that the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that, to the best of each member's knowledge, one, only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements by Virginia law were discussed in the closed meeting to which this certification applies. And two, only such public business matters as were identified in the motion convening the closed meeting were heard, discussed, or considered by

the Loudoun County School Board. Thank you. Mr. Pepper has made a motion to certify the closed meeting. Is there a second? I second. Thank you, Ms. LaBelle. It has been properly moved and seconded that we certify the closed meeting. All those in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. That motion passes unanimously. And finally, Mr. Pepper, do you have another motion? Yes, Madam Chair. I move that the Select Committee of the school board's findings and decisions included in the attached table be adopted and reflected in the

minutes of this public meeting. Thank you. Mr. Pepper has made the motion required by the closed meeting. Is there a second? I second. Thank you, Ms. LaBelle. It has been properly moved and seconded. Let's move forward with the vote. All those in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. That motion passes unanimously. And with that, we have concluded the business of the Select Committee of the School Board for hearing appeals on June 8th, 2026.
